name: High-energy retention edit (MrBeast-style)
description: Long-form edit that tightens pacing, opens on the outcome, and adds a hook and end card. Density is a setting here, not a rule: the creator has said ultra-fast cutting stopped working for him, so this template tightens pauses but does not chase a cut count. Zooms, sound effects and graphics are listed as not available yet.
author: dax-editor contributors

variables.name: title
variables.label: Opening line
variables.example: I gave away a car to a stranger

beats.name: Outcome teaser
beats.guidance: Show or state the outcome and the stakes before any setup.
beats.footage: The most striking moment of the video.

beats.name: Setup and rules
beats.guidance: Explain the challenge in plain words. Let scenes breathe.

beats.name: Escalation
beats.guidance: Raise the stakes in steps; give each step a clear change of scene.

deferred.title: Frequent zooms
deferred.description: Quick punch-in zooms on reactions and reveals.

deferred.title: Sound effects
deferred.description: Short sound effects on cuts and reveals.

deferred.title: On-screen graphics
deferred.description: Text and icons to re-engage attention when it dips.

deferred.title: B-roll inserts
deferred.description: Cutaway shots over the main footage.

deferred.title: Transitions
deferred.description: Quick wipes and zoom-throughs between scenes.

deferred.title: Music bed
deferred.description: Music under the action, lowered under speech.

notes.text: Use only music you have the right to use: a licensed or CC0 library, or your own. Do not reuse a platform's in-app sound library on other platforms, and check that the licence covers paid ads if you promote the video.
Footage, images, memes, logos and music from other people need permission or a licence that covers your use. Fair use depends on the country and is not automatic.
Challenge and stunt videos: do not encourage dangerous behaviour, and make sure everyone on camera knows the risks and agreed to take part.
If the video features a giveaway or prize, check the platform's promotion rules and the law where you and your viewers live.
The style name describes a publicly discussed editing pattern. This template is not affiliated with or endorsed by any creator, and it does not copy anyone's footage, graphics or captions.
